observations.why: Directive issued as a standing mandate — positional authority setting an enforced cadence.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic equivalence claim arguing from operational knowledge — rehearsal equals capability — to justify the cadence mandate.
Recording the decided cadence as a factual specification — supplying the controlling fact of the schedule.
Assigning ownership to the position-holder — naming who holds authority over the rehearsal process.
